description: This file defines the CellRenderer class responsible for rendering table cells into RTF format within the MigraDoc document generation library. It handles rendering cell content, applying styles, and managing cell merging.

classes.name: CellRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of a table cell into RTF format, including its content and style.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the cell into RTF, including content and style formatting.

methods.name: CellRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a document object and a renderer context.

methods.name: CellList
methods.description: Property setter to assign the list of merged cells this renderer operates on.
